Electric Scooter – Foldable Commuter E-Scooter for Adults
Experience a smarter and more efficient way to travel with this high-performance electric scooter. Powered by a 350W rear hub motor (460W peak output), it delivers smooth acceleration and a top speed of up to 31 km/h (19 mph), making it ideal for daily commuting, campus travel, and urban rides.
The 36V rechargeable battery provides a maximum range of up to 25 km (16 miles) on a single charge, while the foldable design allows for easy storage and transportation. Weighing only 15.65 kg (34.5 lbs), this scooter combines portability with durability.
Built for riders aged 16–50 years and supporting a maximum load of 100 kg (220 lbs), it offers reliable performance on a variety of road conditions. With a climbing capability of up to 15°, IPX4 water resistance, and a charging time of just 5–7 hours, it is designed to keep up with your everyday mobility needs.
Key FeaturesPowerful 350W motor (460W peak)Top speed up to 31 km/h (19 mph)Maximum range up to 25 km (16 miles)Foldable and lightweight designSupports riders up to 100 kg (220 lbs)Climbs slopes up to 15°IPX4 water-resistant rating36V battery system with fast chargingCharging time: 5–7 hoursCompact size when folded for easy carrying and storage
Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, or enjoying a weekend ride, this electric scooter offers the perfect balance of power, portability, and convenience.
